label: ASHLAR · Hầm mộ & hang động (dungeon)
coordinateSystem: three.js right-handed, Y up. WORLD coordinates: x east, z south (toward the default camera), y up. The crypt is centred at (-17, 0), the cave at (18, 0); the AREA-LOCAL coordinates of env/dungeon.js are world minus the area centre.
rotation: rotationEulerDeg = Euler degrees in the stated order (YXZ); yawDeg = rotation about +Y (three.js Object3D.rotation.y).
transform: props: compose(position, yaw, uniform scale) * the GLB (the lab GLBs are the ASHLAR source GLBs rescaled to real size by uniform k, baked yaw, bottom-centre pivot; optimized GLBs are in the SOURCE frame: use scaleForOptimizedGlb). Crypt wall modules (instanced "crypt wall") use the same convention as oldFace walls: compose(position, Euler YXZ(tilt, yaw), (sx, sy, 1)) * crypt_wall GLB (4 m wide, front +z).

labFromOptimized.horizontalExtents: no quarter turn (yaw 0 or 180 deg, plus small squaring-up yaws)
labFromOptimized.note: lab GLB = uniform scale k of the optimized (source-frame) GLB, baked yaw, re-pivoted to the bottom centre of the bbox; the lab bbox sizes are in labBbox, the optimized in optBbox. Yaw offsets that bbox sizes cannot show (180 deg, small squaring yaws) are NOT recovered: compare visually.
